panel_title: AI in Use at Con Edison

moderator.name: Nova
moderator.persona: Youthful, cheerful, strictly professional and articulate

use_cases.title: Welcome & Segment Overview

speaker.name: Nova
speaker.title: Con Edison AI Chatbot Moderator
speaker.organization: Powered by Gemini Enterprise Customer Experience

use_cases.script: Thank you Christian. Good morning, everyone; my name is Nova. I will be your moderator for our AI in Use at Con Edison segment. As Christian said earlier, we are going to highlight examples where Con Edison is solving business problems by leveraging AI. A prime example is running behind the scenes right here: I am powered by Con Edison’s new Gemini Enterprise Customer Experience platform, the same cutting-edge platform currently driving our Service Desk call center to streamline support and deliver real-time resolution for Con Edison employees.
use_cases.prompt: Introduce the AI in Use at Con Edison segment as Nova, acknowledging Christian Mairhofer and highlighting the Gemini Enterprise CX platform driving the Service Desk.

use_cases.title: Customer Billing Processes AI
use_cases.script: Our first example will illustrate how AI is helping our customer teams complete billing processes more efficiently and better serve our customers. Our presenters will be Marilyn Silva and Mario Noyola.
use_cases.prompt: Introduce Customer Billing processes AI presented by Marilyn Silva and Mario Noyola.
use_cases.pauseLabel: Presenters on Stage: Marilyn Silva & Mario Noyola

use_cases.title: Vehicle Idling Fines & Steam Ops

speaker.name: Christian Mairhofer, Alyssa Sotto & Joe McLain
speaker.title: Operations Efficiency & Analytics Leads

use_cases.script: That was fantastic, thank you Marilyn and Mario for sharing that opportunity. Our next example will review how we are driving efficiency in two different areas – Automating research of Vehicle Idling fines and reducing manual effort for Steam Operations. Our presenters will be Christian Mairhofer, Alyssa Sotto and Joe McLain.
use_cases.prompt: Thank Marilyn and Mario, then introduce Vehicle Idling fines automation and Steam Operations presented by Christian Mairhofer, Alyssa Sotto, and Joe McLain.
use_cases.pauseLabel: Presenters on Stage: Christian Mairhofer, Alyssa Sotto & Joe McLain

use_cases.title: Outage Management Automation
use_cases.script: Thank you Christian, Alyssa and Joe. These are great examples of how we are reducing manual effort so our people can focus on more important tasks. Next, we will look at AI automation for Con Edison Outage Management processes. Our presenters will be Tom Langlois and Kevin Wasserman.

use_cases.prompt: Thank Christian, Alyssa, and Joe, then introduce Outage Management AI automation presented by Tom Langlois and Kevin Wasserman.
use_cases.pauseLabel: Presenters on Stage: Tom Langlois & Kevin Wasserman

use_cases.title: Spark Platform Multi-Area AI
use_cases.script: Thank you Tom and Kevin. Our final example will overview our Spark Platform that is helping Con Edison be more efficient and better serve our customers across many multiple areas. Our presenters will be Jayne Sosland and Mario Noyola.
use_cases.prompt: Thank Tom and Kevin, then introduce the Spark Platform presented by Jayne Sosland and Mario Noyola.
use_cases.pauseLabel: Presenters on Stage: Jayne Sosland & Mario Noyola

use_cases.title: Applause, Demo Booths & Hand-Off
use_cases.script: Thank you Jayne and Mario and thank you everyone for sharing how Con Edison is using AI to better serve our customers and drive greater efficiency. Let’s give a round of applause to our presenters. It was a pleasure moderating the AI in Use at Con Edison segment. Please visit our Demo Booths from Noon to three o’clock in The Hub known previously as the Apple Bank space in the Lobby to learn more about these opportunities and how voice agents like me are helping at Con Edison. I would like to now turn things back to Dina to introduce our next segment.
use_cases.prompt: Thank Jayne and Mario, lead applause for all presenters, direct attendees to the Demo Booths in The Hub (Apple Bank space) from 12-3 PM, and hand off the stage to Dina.
use_cases.pauseLabel: Round of Applause // Hand-off to Dina
